item: the law coverage report places every language-floor country in one of four states and tallies the twelve languages, zh on its own line
summary: v0.6.0 row C slice S1 (C-L1). law-coverage.json and the Living sources law entry gain a floor block: every country in configs/language_countries.yml (140, read through src.civic.coverage_floor.load_floor, all three bases kept and labelled) is tracked, verified-not-yet-tracked, unverified or no-eligible-source, never a blank, plus a per-language tally (twelve rows, zh its own line first, hk/mo named beside it and not added to the floor), the floor file's own unverified status as a visible caveat, and the documents that state no country counted apart. On the shipped catalogue: 5 tracked on a freshly seeded install, 109 verified-not-yet-tracked, 25 unverified, 1 no-eligible-source (Yemen). Verified means either channel, kept apart elsewhere: research status fetched or search-verified, or an adapter that read the host live or a fixture. A source filed under eu or int is credited to no single country, an IP office or a case-law site makes no country reachable, a document that states no country is credited to none, a tracked IP-office or case-law document credits none (counted by class), a country is never inferred from a jurisdiction code, and an unreadable catalogue reads as unchecked and never as no source. Counts and lists only: no fraction exists in the block. NOT done: the ruled order of work (many-country sources first, then by population reached) is applied only to the first half; within a state countries are listed by code, because the tree holds no dated population table and the sandbox cannot fetch one (the report and the panel say so). Bytes (the diagnostics room is net-zero): the block adds 5,774 B to law-coverage.json; the same commit states each coverage reason once instead of once per jurisdiction and drops the country key each untracked figure repeated, so the member is +4,646 B on a young install (8 jurisdictions) and -20,785 B on a 54-jurisdiction one. 28 new locale keys x12, non-English AI-drafted and flagged for native review.
